source: Readiness Researcher Phase 1 — 174-item healthcare bond readiness scoring framework

items.name: IRS 501(c)(3) determination letter
items.question: Does your organization have a current IRS 501(c)(3) determination letter?

items.name: Articles of Incorporation & Bylaws
items.question: Are your Articles of Incorporation and Bylaws current and reflecting all amendments?

items.name: Board authorization resolution
items.question: Has your board passed (or can it pass within 4 weeks) a resolution authorizing this bond transaction?

items.name: Existing debt schedule & bond documents
items.question: Do you have a complete inventory of all outstanding debt and bond documents?

items.name: Pending litigation
items.question: Are there any pending material litigation matters (claims above $1M or 1% of revenue)?

items.name: State hospital operating license
items.question: Is your state hospital operating license current through the projected closing date?

items.name: Medicare Certification (CMS-855)
items.question: Is your Medicare certification (CMS-855) current and in good standing?

items.name: Medicaid Provider Agreement
items.question: Is your Medicaid provider agreement current and in good standing?

items.name: Certificate of Need (CON)
items.question: Are you in a CON state? If yes, do you have CON approval for your capital project?

items.name: Audited financial statements (3 years)
items.question: Do you have completed audited financial statements for the 3 most recent fiscal years?

items.name: Interim financial statements (YTD)
items.question: Do you have interim financial statements within the last 60-90 days?

items.name: 5-year financial projections
items.question: Do you have 5-year financial projections that align with your strategic plan?

items.name: Days cash on hand (DCOH)
items.question: What is your current Days Cash on Hand (DCOH)?

items.name: Debt service coverage ratio (DSCR)
items.question: What is your most recent Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR)?

items.name: Existing rate covenant compliance
items.question: Have any existing bond covenants been breached or waived in the last 3 years?

items.name: Average daily census (3-year trend)
items.question: Do you track and can you provide 3-year average daily census (ADC) data?

items.name: Feasibility study
items.question: Have you commissioned an independent feasibility study for this project?

items.name: Environmental assessment (Phase I ESA)
items.question: Have you completed a Phase I Environmental Site Assessment for the project site?

items.name: Architect/engineer plans
items.question: Do you have architectural/engineering plans at any stage (schematic or beyond) for the project?

items.name: Rating agency presentation package
items.question: Have you prepared (or begun preparing) a rating agency presentation package?

items.name: Strategic plan (3-5 year)
items.question: Do you have a current strategic plan (3-5 year) that aligns with financial projections?

items.name: Continuing Care / Residency Agreements
items.question: Do you have all continuing care/residency agreement forms (Type A/B/C) available for review?

items.name: Entrance fee refund policy documentation
items.question: Is your entrance fee refund policy fully documented with refund obligation quantification?

items.name: State CCRC license / Certificate of Authority
items.question: Is your state CCRC license / Certificate of Authority current?

items.name: Actuarial feasibility study
items.question: Do you have a current actuarial feasibility study? When was it last updated?

items.name: Entrance fee cash flow model
items.question: Do you have a current entrance fee cash flow model (receipts, refunds, net cash flow projections)?

items.name: Occupancy rates by level of care (3-year trend)
items.question: What are your current occupancy rates by level of care (IL, AL, SNF, Memory Care)?

items.name: Waitlist depth and conversion rate
items.question: What is your current waitlist depth (ratio to annual turnover) and deposit-to-move-in conversion rate?

items.name: Absorption / fill-up schedule
items.question: Do you have a realistic absorption/fill-up schedule with evidence from comparable projects?

items.name: Pre-sale / priority deposit count
items.question: What is your current pre-sale/priority deposit percentage? (Most underwriters require 50-70%)

items.name: Active HRSA Section 330 grant (H80 award)
items.question: Is your HRSA Section 330 grant (H80 award) current with no conditions?

items.name: HRSA scope of project (approved sites & services)
items.question: Does the proposed capital project fall within your currently approved HRSA scope of project?

items.name: BPHC Operational Site Visit (OSV) results
items.question: What were the results of your most recent BPHC Operational Site Visit? Any outstanding conditions?

items.name: Section 330 compliance (19 program requirements)
items.question: Can you demonstrate compliance with all 19 Section 330 program requirements (governance, sliding fee, QI/QA, etc.)?

items.name: FTCA deeming letter (current)
items.question: Is your FTCA (Federal Tort Claims Act) deeming letter current?

items.name: Board composition — 51%+ patient majority
items.question: Does your board have 51%+ patient majority as required by Section 330?

items.name: HRSA property records & federal interest inventory
items.question: Have you compiled a complete HRSA property record with federal interest calculations for all HRSA-funded assets?

items.name: Single Audit findings & corrective action plans
items.question: Were there any findings on your most recent Single Audit? Are corrective action plans in place?

items.name: Operating margin (with and without grant revenue)
items.question: What is your operating margin with and without federal grant revenue?

items.name: HRSA Change in Scope (CIS) approval
items.question: If adding a new site or service type, do you have HRSA Change in Scope (CIS) approval?

items.name: Community needs assessment (CNA)
items.question: Is your Community Needs Assessment (CNA) current (within 3 years)?
